name: Beef Fillet with Marmite Mash and Roasted Cabbage
subtitle: Tender beef with savory mash and caramelized cabbage
description: Roast beef fillet and cabbage, then serve with creamy potato mash blended with Marmite butter.

ingredients.item: beef fillet cut from the middle of the whole fillet
pointed or hispi cabbage cut in half through the middle
King Edward or Maris Piper potatoes
whole milk or double cream or use 50ml each

instructions.text: Combine the softened unsalted butter with the Marmite. Chill until firm, then divide into portions.
Preheat the oven. Prepare the beef and cabbage while it heats.
Heat the butter in an ovenproof pan for 10 minutes, then sear the beef fillet briefly on all sides. Cut the cabbage half as needed and prepare it with the butter mixture.
Roast the beef for 5 minutes, then continue cooking for 15 minutes, or until a thermometer reads 145°F at the center. Rest for at least 3 minutes before slicing.
Cook the potatoes and cabbage until cooked through, about 12 minutes. Drain the potatoes.
Mash the potatoes with the milk or cream and the remaining softened butter. Stir in the Marmite butter until smooth.
Serve the sliced beef with the thick mash and roasted cabbage.
